summary: Rockstar's Midnight Club series focuses on open-city arcade street racing, with Midnight Club 3 especially split between original DUB Edition and the expanded Remix release.

entries.title: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition
entries.definitive_edition: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix on PS2/Xbox where available

emulation.notes: Use owned media and record emulator settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2/Xbox Remix route with platform and content state documented

primary.version: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix when available
primary.why: Remix is the expanded route, adding Tokyo and extra vehicles/music, while the original DUB Edition remains the launch baseline. There is no current normal PC route, so archive capture depends on owned PS2/Xbox/PSP media and accurate hardware/emulation.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PS2 or Xbox copy, preferably Remix for complete content. Record platform, original vs Remix, city, career progress, vehicle/unlock state, customization, music/licensing state, controller, emulator/hardware, and whether PSP behavior was compared.

secondary.why: PS2/Xbox Remix is the complete main route.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded route with Tokyo, vehicles, and additional content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original DUB Edition and Remix differ; music/licensing and platform performance should be documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record original vs Remix, music, city/progress, and platform/emulator state.
